title: Keep Bevy resource access compatible
why: Requesting the same Bevy resource more than once when one access is mutable fails system parameter validation and panics at runtime.
suggestion: Keep one ResMut or NonSendMut parameter and use it for both reading and writing, or place genuinely sequential conflicting parameters in a ParamSet.
limitations: Direct Res, ResMut, NonSend, and NonSendMut parameters are compared by their written type; aliases and custom SystemParam wrappers are not resolved.
Extract parameters are treated as main-world access distinct from render-world parameters; conflicts caused by broad entity queries in versions where resources are components are not inferred.
